text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the Satsuki Sho reaches its climax, Admire Vega lets out a roar. Her desire to best her rivals burns like a flame. But in the end, she loses to T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her passion holds strong even after returning to the academy. There, she sees Narita Top Road preparing for the next race, the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she wonders aloud about her competition's progress and what it means for the future, I note that she's finally expressing excitement over her upcoming races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no doubt that she's beginning to appreciate the joy of racing against her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However… despite the welcome change, the skies remain bleak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With signs of significant change on the horizon, we begin counting down the days to the Japanese Derby.
